links.outcome: Rate of clinically plausible AHP cases (precision) in AI human-in-the-loop screening versus standard of care
links.effect: 74 (38.74%) of 191 HAI cases vs 28 (27.72%) of 107 SOC cases were clinically plausible; 46 de-novo cases missed by SOC; difference not statistically significant.
links.quote: In our study, our proposed HAI screening approach showed a higher plausibility rate in suspected cases compared to the SOC and statistical testing could not find a statistically significant difference between the screening methods.

unlisted_practices: Human-in-the-loop triage of AI screening flags by generalist physicians followed by specialist physician review of full EHRs, to find rare-disease cases
